text: The Quartz Corp AS, the Norwegian high-purity quartz producer at Drag, is a 100 per cent subsidiary of The Quartz Corp SAS, which since 2011 has been under shared ownership with the French company Imerys (per TQC's Transparency Act statement); a company article describes the ownership as shared between French Imerys and Norway's Norsk Mineral.
short: The Quartz Corp AS is wholly owned by The Quartz Corp SAS (Imerys and Norsk Mineral shared ownership).

source.name: The Quartz Corp - Transparency Act (Åpenhetsloven) statement 2025
source.quote: The Quartz Corp AS (TQC AS) er et 100% datterselskap av The Quartz Corp SAS

additionalSources.name: The Quartz Corp article: Høyteknologisk industrieventyr på Hamarøy (28 Nov 2023)
additionalSources.quote: The Quartz Corp har delt eierskap mellom franske Imerys og Norsk Mineral, og har sterk norsk forankring.
